refusedWhenOff.error: The owner turned off letting you control the computer (Settings → Desktop pet). Tell them you'd like to use it.

refusedWithoutPet.error: The desktop pet is not running. Ask the owner to turn it on (Settings → Desktop pet). Paste a screenshot if you need to work from one.

notes.perryPet:
Perry on your desktop
  Click him for your chats, to-dos and what needs you; drag him anywhere. Ctrl+Shift+Space talks to him.
  He starts with your computer from now on; perry pet off stops that.
  The first time he looks at your screen, macOS asks you to allow Electron (the app he runs in) to record it; restart him from his tray icon after.

  ✔ installed
  ✔ Electron ready
  ✔ on your screen
